title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Mataawwaan waliiwwan guddaa fi barsiisuu qixxeessuu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, mataawwaan waliiwwan guddaa fi barsiisuu qixxeessuu barbaachisaa adverbi (e.g., 'somewhat', 'arguably'), fi ilmaan muddalaa suurrii (e.g., 'might', 'could'), fi seentence essee jiraatan (e.g., 'although', 'while') hin jiru. Afaan Oromoo fi Afaan Ingilizii waliiwwan guddaa fi barsiisuu qixxeessuu danda'an akkas jedhanii jiraatan (e.g., 'dhugaa', 'kanas') barbaachisu. Akkasumas, 'dhugaa' akkas jedhanii jiraatan 'although' fi 'though' akkas jedhanii jiraatan barbaachisu.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti mataawwaan waliiwwan guddaa fi barsiisuu qixxeessuu barbaachisaa: 1) Adverbii waliiwwan (e.g., 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') kanaa haalaa qabduu kan danda'amu. 2) Ilmaan muddalaa suurrii (might, may, could) kan danda'amu. 3) Jiraatan essee (although, even though, while, whereas) kan danda'amu. 4) 'It could be argued that...', 'one might say that...', 'this is not to say that...' akkas jedhanii jiraatan kan danda'amu. Seentence essee jiraatan keessatti waliiwwan guddaa fi barsiisuu qixxeessuu barbaachisaa.

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Fannaan fi Suuraa Gaaffii
bridge: Afaan Oromo, fannaan fi suuraa gaaffii kennu ‘dhorga’, ‘kanatti’ jewi ‘haqimmachiis’ dubbifama hin jiru. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, qorannaan barbaachisaa (may, might, could), barbaacha sirrii (highly, somewhat, arguably) fi maqaalataa miti (It is worth noting) barbaachisuudha. Fakkeenya caalaa kan ‘must’ akkasumas ‘debe ser’ hin ta’e hojjetaa; ‘must’ afaan Ingilizii keessatti barbaacha qofa hin taane. ‘I would argue’ ‘I think definitely’ irra deebisu akkasumas fannaan barbaachisaa qofa hin taane.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti fannaan fi suuraa gaaffii barbaachisuuf: 1) Qorannaan barbaachisaa: ‘must’ (barbaacha qofa), ‘may/might/could’ (barbaacha kanarraa), ‘can't’ (barbaacha hin qabne). 2) Barbaacha sirrii: ‘highly’, ‘extremely’, ‘somewhat’, ‘arguably’, ‘undoubtedly’. 3) Maqaalataa miti: ‘It is worth noting that...’, ‘It could be argued that...’, ‘The evidence suggests...’. 4) Qorannaan maqaa: ‘I would argue’, ‘I contend’, ‘I maintain’ (kan ‘I think’ irra caalaa). 5) Sirnaa ta’an: ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’, ‘whereas’. ‘I think’ barumsaa baafachaatti hin kennu; ‘This implies that...’ jewi ‘It could be inferred that...’ kennu. Suuraa gaaffii, ‘strengths and weaknesses’, ‘implications’, ‘limitations’ kennu.

title: Irony and Understatement / Ayirree, sarkaasumii fi afaan eufemism
bridge: Afaan Oromo, ayirree fi sarkaasumii hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'kanas', 'hundaa', 'hin'), fi biroo hin qabdu akkamuma hin qabdu godhanii akkamuma hin qabdu. Afaan Ingilizii, ayirree hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'not bad', 'excellent'), fi eufemism hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'passed away', 'died'). Ayirree fi sarkaasumii hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect', 'I love it when...'). Eufemism hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'let go', 'fired', 'between jobs', 'unemployed', 'full-figured', 'fat').
rule: Afaan Ingilizii warri C1, ayirree fi eufemism hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti: 1) Understatement: adafaa fi adabbii adhee (fakkaataa, 'It's not the worst idea', 'a bit', 'slightly'). 2) Sarcasum: hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect', 'I love it when...'). 3) Eufemism: hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti (fakkaataa, 'passed away', 'died', 'let go', 'fired', 'between jobs', 'unemployed', 'full-figured', 'fat'). Adabbii adhee ('hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') fi understatement; galmeessumma ('Is that so?') fi ayirree; duwwawn walqixxummaa miti ('just', 'only', 'a bit') fakkaataa. Hin kamiyyuu: ayirree hunda kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti; sarkaasumii hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti. Eufemism hanga kanarraa fi duwwawn walqixxummaa miti.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Qabxii walitti dhaabbataa fi irraa qabdu dubbii akkas godhatamaa
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, qabxii walitti dhaabbataa hinka’in malee tokko tokko kan danda’an godhu akkas godhamee, akkasumas ‘Mana dhihaa ta’ee?’ jedhanii wajjin haasa’aa ta’e. Afaan Ingilizii, qabxii walitti dhaabbataa akkas godhamee hordofsiifamee, bara dhaabbataa moddaaliif (could, would), galmee hin kennamne, fi irra deebi’anii (I was wondering) dubbii akkas godhamee kan danda’u godhu. Afaan Oromo essummaa Afaan Ingilizii akkas godhamee hin kennamne dhaabbataa akkas godhamee kan godhu, kana malees jabaa’in akkas godhame. Akkasumas, qabxii walitti dhaabbataa (dhaabbii) tokko tokko kan danda’u godhu; Afaan Ingilizii, namootaa dhaabbii hin kennamne akkas godhamee kan godhu, garuu qabxii walitti dhaabbataa akkas godhame.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii, qabxii walitti dhaabbataa akkas godhamee kan godhu: 1) Galmee ‘can/could/would you...’ dubbii akkas godhamee (Could you close the window?), 2) ‘I was wondering if...’ dubbii akkas godhamee (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Galmee hin kennamne dubbii akkas godhamee (Don't you think it's too late?), 4) ‘It might be a good idea to...’ dubbii akkas godhamee. Qabxii walitti dhaabbataa, Grice’s maxims dubbii akkas godhame; ‘I'm cold’ dubbii akkas godhamee, mana dhihaa ta’e jedha. C1, bara dhaabbataa akkas godhamee fi dhaabbii akkas godhamee kan godhu.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Daandiiwwan sirnaawwan dhaabachuu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, nama tokko tokko ‘guyyaa’, ‘kanarratti’, ‘hanga’ jechuun dhaabachuu wajjin hojjeta. Afaan Ingilizii, daandiiwwan sirnaawwan dhaabachuu qixaanaa fi baay’ee kan danda’an hojjeta, ‘firstly’, ‘furthermore’, ‘but more importantly’, fi ‘in light of this’ jechuun akkas. Akkasumas, ‘on one side’ jechuun ‘on the one hand’ jechuun, ‘in conclusion’ jechuun ‘to sum up’ jechuun akkas fiduu danda’uudha. Akkasumas, adaarsoota afaan Ingilizii fi qabduu suuraa akkas fiduu danda’uudha: afaan Ingilizii suuraa sirrii fi baay’ee kan danda’an hojjeta, afaan Oromo gosa suuraa kan danda’an hojjeta.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii (C1) daandiiwwan sirnaawwan dhaabachuu, daandiiwwan sirnaawwan dhaabachuu qixaanaa fi baay’ee kan danda’an hojjeta. Guyyaa, ‘I would like to begin by...’, ‘Let me start by...’, ‘The purpose of this presentation is to...’ jechuun akkas. Seera: ‘Firstly’, ‘Secondly’, ‘Furthermore’, ‘Moreover’, ‘In addition’. Akkasumas: ‘However’, ‘On the other hand’, ‘Nevertheless’. Akkasumas: ‘Indeed’, ‘In fact’, ‘It is important to note that’. Akkasumas: ‘In conclusion’, ‘To summarize’, ‘In light of the evidence’. Akkasumas, ‘we’ jechuun akkas fiduu danda’uudha (hanga ‘we can see that...’). Akkasumas, entonation fi pausing, grammaar essuudhaan, daandiiwwan sirnaawwan dhaabachuu wajjin hojjeta. Adaarsoota afaan Ingilizii fi qabduu suuraa akkas fiduu danda’uudha: suuraa sirrii fi baay’ee kan danda’an hojjeta, afaan Oromo gosa suuraa kan danda’an hojjeta.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Gadaa fi Qajeelfama Tokkummaa Bara Baafachuu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, fidhateen walakkaa akkas jechuu ‘dha’ akkas jechuufi ‘kan dandeessu’ akkas jechuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, garuu afaan Ingilizii bara baafachuu hedging akkas jechuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, modaal verbs, adverbs of probability akkas jechuufi opinion verbs akkas jechuu ‘suggest’ akkas jechuu ‘appear’ akkas jechuu. Qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, ‘it is possible that’ akkas jechuu ‘may’ akkas jechuu ‘could’ akkas jechuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee. Qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, afaan Ingilizii bara baafachuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii bara baafachuu, qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee. Qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee: 1) Modaal verbs: may, might, could (p.ej., 'This may indicate...'), 2) Adverbs of frequency/probability: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (p.ej., 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Opinion verbs: suggest, appear, seem (p.ej., 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Impersonal expressions: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, adverbs akkas jechuu clearly, undoubtedly, definitively, akkas jechuufi verbs akkas jechuu prove, demonstrate. Qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee, afaan Ingilizii bara baafachuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee. Afaan Ingilizii bara baafachuu, pronoun 'I' akkas jechuu qajeelfama tokkummaa bara baafachuu wajjin tokko ta’ee.

title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Urjiiwwan Kutaa Xixxoo
bridge: Afaan Oromo, guyyaa dursuu keessatti, wanti hundaa’eeraatiif godhi deebii qabnu dha. Afaan Ingiliffaatti, urjiiwwan kutaa xixxoo barbaachisaa fi barbaachuu kan danda’amu godhanii (would, could, might), walitti dhuunfa’uu fi du’aa mitiif godhanii guutuu jiraatanii. Afaan Ingiliffi ‘unless’ fi ‘provided that’ jechuun barbaachisaa guutuu jiraachuu danda’amu godhanii akkas ilaalchisee hin qabnu dha. ‘I was wondering if’ jechuunis du’aa mitiif godhu godhaa ta’ee, Afaan Oromoitti du’aa mitiif godhu godhaa ta’uudhaaf kennamuu akka ta’ee godhu godhaa dha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa urjiiwwan kutaa xixxoo godhachuu danda’amuu kan danda’amuu: 1) Walitti dhuunfa’uu (first, second, third) barbaachisaa guutuu jiraachuu danda’amuu: ‘If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount’. 2) Godhanii barbaachisaa fi barbaachuu kan danda’amuu: ‘I would suggest’, ‘We could consider’, ‘I might be open to’. 3) ‘Although’, ‘however’, ‘while’ jechuun barbaachisaa fi barbaachuu kan danda’amuu. 4) ‘Meet you halfway’, ‘a win-win situation’, ‘bottom line’ jechuun barbaachisaa fi barbaachuu kan danda’amuu. 5) ‘Unless’, ‘provided that’, ‘as long as’ jechuun barbaachisaa guutuu jiraachuu danda’amuu: ‘We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs’. 6) Du’aa mitiif godhu godhaa ta’ee, ‘I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule’. ‘I want’ jechuun barbaachisaa hin danda’amuu; ‘I would like’ fi ‘We are looking for’ jechuun barbaachisaa danda’amuu. ‘I don’t like it’ jechuun barbaachisaa hin danda’amuu; ‘I’m not entirely comfortable with that’ jechuun barbaachisaa danda’amuu.

title: Nuanced Expression of Attitude / Attaa fi suuraa hojiiwwan dhaabbataa
bridge: Afaan Oromoo, nama tokko tokko qajeelfama kennu haa ta’e malee, attummaa fi suuraa hojiiwwan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu. Afaan Ingiliffii, barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu, barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu, barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu, barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii C1 dhaabbaa, attummaa fi suuraa hojiiwwan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu: (1) Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu (may, might, could, would, should) barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu, barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu; (2) Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu (arguably, admittedly, typically, surprisingly) barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu; (3) Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu (It's fair to say, It could be argued that) barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu; (4) Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu (I'd suggest, I'd maintain, I'd contend) barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu. Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu, ‘not’ + ‘at all’, ‘hardly’, ‘scarcely’ barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu. ‘I think’ ammas ‘I believe’ barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu. Barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu ‘It would seem that’ ammas ‘It might be argued’ barbaachisaa akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu akkamii akakaa’uu kan danda’an qabnu argisiisu.

title: Register Shifting / Konteektiin miti baasiinsa malee jiru
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, miti baasiinsa malee jiru qophaa lamaa ta'e barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa tokko tokkoo kennuudhaan hojjetu. Afaan Ispeenichii keessatti, miti baasiinsa malee jiru barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa tokko tokkoo kennuudhaan hojjetu, garuu afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, miti baasiinsa malee jiru qophaa lamaa ta'e barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa tokko tokkoo kennuudhaan hojjetu. Namoonni afaan Ispeenichii qajeelfama barbaachummaa hundaa akka ta'e barbaachisaa hundaa godhaman, haala malee barbaachummaa hundaa akka ta'e barbaachisaa hundaa godhaman, haala malee barbaachummaa hundaa akka ta'e barbaachisaa hundaa godhaman, haala malee barbaachummaa hundaa akka ta'e barbaachisaa hundaa godhaman. Kana malee, afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, miti baasiinsa malee jiru qophaa lamaa ta'e barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa tokko tokkoo kennuudhaan hojjetu.
rule:
Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, miti baasiinsa malee jiru konteektiin miti baasiinsa malee jiru (barbaachisaa, barbaachummaa, fi barbaachummaa) kennuudhaan hojjetu:

1. Qophaa lamaa: Qophaa lamaa barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa (fakkaachaa 'purchase' vs 'buy', 'receive' vs 'get', 'child' vs 'kid').
2. Baafacha: Baafacha haqisaa (baafacha haqisaa, barbaachisaa) barbaachummaa; baafacha haqisaa fi baafacha haqisaa barbaachummaa.
3. Modaali fi hedges: 'Would', 'could', 'might', 'perhaps', 'possibly' barbaachummaa; konteektiin barbaachummaa 'can', 'will', 'maybe'.
4. Phrasal verbs: Barbaachummaa ama barbaachummaa; barbaachisaa barbaachummaa (fakkaachaa 'to carry out' vs 'to execute').
5. Contracciones: Barbaachisaa barbaachummaa (fakkaachaa 'don't' hin jiru 'do not').
6. Fórmulas fijas: Barbaachisaa barbaachummaa ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'Yours faithfully').
7. Pronombres: Barbaachummaa 'one' hin jiru 'you' barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa (fakkaachaa 'One must consider...').

Excepciones: Afaan Ingiliffii Britaanniin barbaachummaa barbaachisaa barbaachummaa. Barbaachummaa barbaachisaa barbaachummaa, barbaachummaa barbaachisaa barbaachummaa, barbaachummaa barbaachisaa barbaachummaa. Miti baasiinsa malee jiru qophaa lamaa ta'e barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa tokko tokkoo kennuudhaan hojjetu.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Urjiiwwan Pragmaatikiin Kana Malee Oromoomaa
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, adabbi fi amantii hin qabdu murtoo qorattoota seenaa (qorattoota kondishanal, foormulaa’iin baase, hiperbiilee) hin godhanne. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haa ta’ee ingilizii fi ofiisiiwwan keessatti, suuraa baaseefi adabbiin hojii irra deebisu godhan ta’u malees hin kennamne. Namoota afaan Ispeenyaa qaama kanarraa waan hundaa’eeraa fi qorattoota seenaa hundaa’uudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, mana hidhaa fi mana dhiisuu qofa ta’e. Qorattoota ‘maybe’ hin qabdu ‘quizas’ jedhanii ‘baje el tono’ jedhu; ‘I think’ afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘creo’ afaan Ispeenyaa keessatti kan hin kennine.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, adabbi pragmaatikiin hojii irra deebisu: 1) Hedges (‘sort of’, ‘kind of’, ‘I’d say’), 2) Qorattoota moodal lamaa baase (would, could, might) mana hidhaa irra deebisu, 3) Galaan lamaa baase (‘couldn’t we…?’), 4) Foormulaa’iin adabbiin ‘I’m afraid’, ‘I’d rather’. Afaan Ispeenyaa keessatti, adabbi kondishanal (‘me gustaría’, ‘podrías’) godhan ta’e, garuu qorattoota baasee hin kennamne. Amanamummaa keessatti, namoota afaan Ingilizii qaama ‘I see your point, but…’ foormulaa’iin amanamummaa ta’u malee, afaan Ispeenyaa keessatti ‘no estoy de acuerdo’ amanamummaa ta’e. C1 keessatti, ‘just’ fi ‘actually’ adabbiin hojii irra deebisu godhaa.
